sync.dialog.title: Synchronize folders

@sync.dialog.title.description: Title of the dialog. Synchronize folders (Shift+F12) is a dialog like Total Commander's Synchronize directories: it compares the folder in the left pane with the one in the right pane, subfolders included, and lists each file with an arrow saying what to copy which way.

@sync.dialog.close.description: Button that closes the Synchronize folders dialog without synchronizing anything. The options are remembered for these two folders.

@sync.dialog.compare.description: Button in the Synchronize folders dialog that compares the two folders with the options above it. Enter in the options does the same.

@sync.dialog.compareAgain.description: Button in the banner that says the list is out of date: compares the two folders again with the current options.

@sync.dialog.synchronize.description: Main button of the Synchronize folders dialog (Cmd+Enter): opens the confirmation that lists everything that will be copied or removed. Nothing is written before that confirmation. The ellipsis says a confirmation follows.

sync.dialog.synchronizeNeedsCompare: Compare the folders first, then review the list before you synchronize.

@sync.dialog.synchronizeNeedsCompare.description: Tooltip of the Synchronize… button while it is unavailable because there is no finished, up-to-date comparison yet.

@sync.dialog.pause.description: Button that pauses the running comparison of the two folders. It takes the place of the Synchronize… button while a comparison runs, as in Total Commander.

@sync.dialog.resume.description: Button that continues a paused comparison of the two folders.

@sync.dialog.stop.description: Button that stops the running comparison of the two folders (Escape does the same). The rows already compared stay listed.

sync.dialog.stale: The options changed since the last compare, so this list may be out of date.

@sync.dialog.stale.description: Banner above the grid after the person changed an option that decides how files are paired or compared (subfolders, compare by, masks, mode). The dialog never compares again on its own; the banner has a "Compare again" button.

sync.dialog.staleFolders: A synchronization changed these folders since this compare.

@sync.dialog.staleFolders.description: Banner above the grid when a synchronization has already written to the folders after this comparison, so the list no longer matches the disk. It has a "Compare again" button.

sync.dialog.comparing: Comparing… {leftFilesText} {leftFiles, plural, one {file} other {files}} on the left, {rightFilesText} {rightFiles, plural, one {file} other {files}} on the right

@sync.dialog.comparing.description: Live status line while the two folders are scanned, updated several times a second.

placeholders.leftFilesText: how many files the left folder scan found so far, formatted
placeholders.leftFiles: the same number, for the plural form
placeholders.rightFilesText: how many files the right folder scan found so far, formatted
placeholders.rightFiles: the same number, for the plural form

sync.dialog.comparingContent: Comparing content: {doneText} of {totalText} {total, plural, one {pair} other {pairs}}

@sync.dialog.comparingContent.description: Live status line while files of equal size are compared byte by byte ("Compare by: Content"). A pair is the same file on the left and on the right.

placeholders.doneText: how many pairs are done, formatted
placeholders.totalText: how many pairs there are, formatted
placeholders.total: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.dialog.paused.description: Status line while the comparison is paused. A short status, no closing period.

@sync.dialog.stopped.description: Status line after the person stopped the comparison. A short status, no closing period.

sync.dialog.optionsNotSaved: Synchronize folders couldn’t remember the options for these two folders, so they start from the defaults next time.

@sync.dialog.optionsNotSaved.description: Notification after the dialog closed, when the options it remembers per pair of folders couldn't be written to disk.

sync.dialog.needsTwoFolders: Synchronize folders needs a folder in each pane.

@sync.dialog.needsTwoFolders.description: Notification when Shift+F12 is pressed while one pane shows something other than a folder (the network list or search results), so there is nothing to compare.

@sync.dialog.optionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the area at the top of the Synchronize folders dialog that holds the two folders, the mode, and the compare options.

@sync.options.left.description: Label before the left folder's path in the Synchronize folders dialog: the folder the left pane shows.

@sync.options.right.description: Label before the right folder's path in the Synchronize folders dialog: the folder the right pane shows.

@sync.options.swap.description: Button (Cmd+U) that swaps the left and right folders and compares again, so the copy direction of the one-way modes turns around.

@sync.options.mode.description: Label of the choice between Compare only, Both ways, Update, and Mirror: what the synchronization does by default.

@sync.options.mode.compareOnly.description: Mode: show the differences and change nothing unless the person sets an action on a row.

@sync.options.mode.bothWays.description: Mode (the default): copy missing and newer files in both directions. It never removes anything.

@sync.options.mode.update.description: Mode: copy missing and newer files from left to right only. It never removes anything. Keep the arrow; it points to the side that changes.

@sync.options.mode.mirror.description: Mode: make the right folder a copy of the left: copies, replaces, and removes on the right. Keep the arrow; it points to the side that changes.

sync.options.modeHint.compareOnly: Shows what differs and changes nothing unless you set an action on a row.

@sync.options.modeHint.compareOnly.description: Tooltip of the Compare only mode.

sync.options.modeHint.bothWays: Copies missing and newer files each way. Never removes anything.

@sync.options.modeHint.bothWays.description: Tooltip of the Both ways mode.

sync.options.modeHint.update: Copies missing and newer files from left to right. Never removes anything.
sync.options.modeHint.mirror: Makes the right folder match the left: copies, replaces, and removes on the right. Replaced and removed files are kept.

@sync.options.modeHint.mirror.description: Tooltip of the Mirror mode. "Kept" means moved to the Trash or a versions folder, never deleted.

@sync.options.compareBy.description: Label of the choice of what decides that two files differ.

@sync.options.compareBy.dateAndSize.description: Compare-by option (the default): files differ when their size or modification date differs.

@sync.options.compareBy.sizeOnly.description: Compare-by option: files differ only when their size differs; dates are left out.

@sync.options.compareBy.content.description: Compare-by option: files of the same size are also compared byte by byte, which reads both files and takes longer.

@sync.options.subfolders.description: Checkbox: compare the folders inside the two folders too, all the way down.

@sync.options.onlySelected.description: Checkbox, as in Total Commander: compare only the items selected in each pane (a pane with nothing selected takes its whole folder).

@sync.options.ignoreDate.description: Checkbox: leave modification dates out, so files differ only by size (or content).

@sync.options.emptyFolders.description: Checkbox, Total Commander's "Empty directories": also list folders that have nothing in them.

@sync.options.masks.description: Label of the field that says which files to compare, as wildcard masks such as *.pdf. After a | come the masks to leave out.

@sync.options.masksPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the empty Files field: every file is compared.

sync.options.masksHint: Masks like *.pdf *.docx. Masks after | are left out. A trailing / means a folder.

@sync.options.masksHint.description: Tooltip of the Files field explaining its syntax. Keep *.pdf, *.docx, |, and / as they are.

@sync.options.excludes.description: Label of the field listing names never compared, such as .DS_Store, separated by semicolons.

sync.options.excludesHint: Names never compared, separated by ;. A trailing / means a folder.

@sync.options.excludesHint.description: Tooltip of the Leave out field. Keep ; and / as they are.

sync.filters.label: Show

@sync.filters.label.description: Accessible name of the row of toggle buttons that show or hide kinds of rows in the grid. Hiding a row never changes what happens to it.

@sync.filters.toRight.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows that will be copied from left to right. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.equal.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows whose two files are the same (hidden by default). Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.different.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows whose files differ but are skipped. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.toLeft.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows that will be copied from right to left, or removed. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.duplicates.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows present in both folders. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.singles.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows present in only one folder. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.unknown.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides rows the comparison couldn't decide, marked ?. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.warningsOnly.description: Toggle button above the grid that shows or hides only the rows where an older file would replace a newer one; turning it on hides every other row. Short: eight of these share one row.

@sync.filters.hiddenMark.description: Accessible text of the "!" mark on a show-filter button that currently hides rows, so hidden rows are never a surprise. Hidden rows still run.

sync.grid.label: Files in both folders

@sync.grid.label.description: Accessible name of the grid listing every file of the two folders side by side with what will happen to it.

@sync.grid.col.mark.description: Accessible name of the narrow first column of the grid, where a checkmark shows a selected row.

@sync.grid.col.leftName.description: Column header: the file's name in the left folder.

@sync.grid.col.rightName.description: Column header: the file's name in the right folder.

@sync.grid.col.size.description: Visible column header for a file size; the grid has one on each side. Short.

@sync.grid.col.date.description: Visible column header for a modification date; the grid has one on each side. Short.

@sync.grid.col.leftSize.description: Column header as screen readers hear it: the size of the file on the left.

@sync.grid.col.leftDate.description: Column header as screen readers hear it: the modification date of the file on the left.

@sync.grid.col.rightSize.description: Column header as screen readers hear it: the size of the file on the right.

@sync.grid.col.rightDate.description: Column header as screen readers hear it: the modification date of the file on the right.

@sync.grid.col.action.description: Column header of the middle column: an arrow or mark saying what the synchronization does with the row. Short.

@sync.grid.folderHeading.description: Heading row in the grid above the files of one subfolder, as Total Commander's grey bars, e.g. "Photos/2024, folder 3 of 12".

placeholders.path: the subfolder's path inside the compared folder, e.g. Photos/2024
placeholders.ordinalText: its position among the listed folders, formatted
placeholders.ofText: how many folders are listed, formatted

sync.grid.empty: No rows to show. The show buttons above may be hiding some.

@sync.grid.empty.description: Shown in place of the grid when the comparison finished but every row is hidden by the show buttons, or the folders hold nothing.

@sync.grid.identical.description: Shown in place of the grid when the comparison found nothing to do and no difference.

sync.grid.rung.presence: Decided by which side has it

@sync.grid.rung.presence.description: Tooltip of a row: the row's category comes from the file being on one side only (or a file against a folder).

@sync.grid.rung.sizeAndTime.description: Tooltip and screen-reader text of the small T badge on a row: size and modification date decided it.

@sync.grid.rung.sizeOnly.description: Tooltip and screen-reader text of the small S badge on a row: the size alone decided it.

@sync.grid.rung.content.description: Tooltip and screen-reader text of the small C badge on a row: the bytes of both files decided it.

@sync.grid.pending.description: Tooltip of the mark on a row whose two files are being compared byte by byte right now.

@sync.grid.changedMark.description: Tooltip of the small mark on a row whose action the person set by hand.

@sync.grid.warningMark.description: Tooltip of the warning mark on a row where the synchronization would replace a newer file with an older one (possible in Mirror).

@sync.grid.spoken.folder.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the name: the row is a folder. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.grid.spoken.changedByYou.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name: the person set this row's action by hand. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.grid.spoken.olderReplacesNewer.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name: the run would replace a newer file with an older one. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.grid.spoken.comparingContent.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name: the two files are being compared byte by byte. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.grid.spoken.selected.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name: the row is selected, so keys act on it. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.leftOnly.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the file exists only in the left folder. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.leftOnly.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the file exists only in the left folder. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.rightOnly.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the file exists only in the right folder. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.rightOnly.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the file exists only in the right folder. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.newerLeft.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the left copy is newer. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.newerLeft.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the left copy is newer. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.newerRight.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the right copy is newer. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.newerRight.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the right copy is newer. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.different.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the two copies differ but neither is newer. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.different.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the two copies differ but neither is newer. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.equal.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the two copies are the same. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.equal.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the two copies are the same. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.unknown.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: the comparison lacks the facts to decide (a missing date, say), marked ?. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.unknown.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: the comparison lacks the facts to decide (a missing date, say), marked ?. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

sync.category.label.typeClash: A file on one side, a folder on the other

@sync.category.label.typeClash.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: one side has a file and the other a folder of the same name. Sentence case.

sync.category.spoken.typeClash: a file on one side and a folder on the other

@sync.category.spoken.typeClash.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: one side has a file and the other a folder of the same name. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

sync.category.label.nameClash: Two names here match one name there

@sync.category.label.nameClash.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: two names on one side, such as A.txt and a.txt, match a single name on the other side, which ignores letter case. Sentence case.

sync.category.spoken.nameClash: two names here match one name there

@sync.category.spoken.nameClash.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: two names on one side, such as A.txt and a.txt, match a single name on the other side, which ignores letter case. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.category.label.unreadable.description: Tooltip of a grid row's category mark: one side couldn't be read. Sentence case.

@sync.category.spoken.unreadable.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after the file name: one side couldn't be read. Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.copyRight.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: the file is copied from left to right (→).

sync.action.spoken.copyRight: will be copied to the right

@sync.action.spoken.copyRight.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: the file is copied from left to right (→). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.copyLeft.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: the file is copied from right to left (←).

sync.action.spoken.copyLeft: will be copied to the left

@sync.action.spoken.copyLeft.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: the file is copied from right to left (←). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.removeRight.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: the right copy is moved to the Trash or the versions folder (×→).

sync.action.spoken.removeRight: will be removed on the right

@sync.action.spoken.removeRight.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: the right copy is moved to the Trash or the versions folder (×→). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.removeLeft.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: the left copy is moved to the Trash or the versions folder (←×).

sync.action.spoken.removeLeft: will be removed on the left

@sync.action.spoken.removeLeft.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: the left copy is moved to the Trash or the versions folder (←×). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.equal.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: both copies are the same (=).

@sync.action.spoken.equal.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: both copies are the same (=). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.skip.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: the row is left alone (·).

@sync.action.spoken.skip.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: the row is left alone (·). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

@sync.action.label.undecided.description: Name of a row action, in tooltips, the row menu, and refusal messages: nobody decided yet; the run leaves it alone until the person sets an action (?).

@sync.action.spoken.undecided.description: Part of a grid row's screen-reader name, after its category: nobody decided yet; the run leaves it alone until the person sets an action (?). Lowercase; it follows a comma.

sync.menu.label: Row actions

@sync.menu.label.description: Accessible name of the menu that opens on a right-click (or Shift+F10) on a grid row.

@sync.menu.selected.description: Section heading in the row menu: these actions apply to every selected row (or the row under the cursor when none is selected).

@sync.menu.row.description: Section heading in the row menu: these actions apply to the row under the cursor.

@sync.menu.defaultDirection.description: Row menu item that puts the actions back to what the mode chose (Cmd+D).

@sync.menu.reverse.description: Row menu item that turns a copy around, or a removal into a copy back (Cmd+I).

@sync.menu.toggleSkip.description: Row menu item that skips a planned action, or restores a skipped one (Space).

@sync.menu.compareContent.description: Row menu item that compares the two files byte by byte (Enter).

@sync.menu.viewLeft.description: Row menu item that opens the left file in the viewer (F3).

@sync.menu.viewRight.description: Row menu item that opens the right file in the viewer (Shift+F3).

@sync.menu.editLeft.description: Row menu item that opens the left file in the text editor (F4).

@sync.menu.editRight.description: Row menu item that opens the right file in the text editor (Shift+F4).

@sync.menu.quickLook.description: Row menu item that shows the left file (or the right one when there is no left one) in macOS Quick Look (Option+Space). Use Apple's name for Quick Look in your language.

@sync.menu.copyRows.description: Row menu item that copies the selected rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text (Cmd+C).

@sync.refusal.illegalForMode.description: Notice when the person presses a key the current mode doesn't allow on the row, e.g. "Remove on the right isn’t possible in this mode." (only Mirror removes; Update and Mirror never write to the left).

placeholders.action: the action's name, e.g. Copy to the left

@sync.refusal.illegalForCategory.description: Notice when the row's kind doesn't allow the action, e.g. a name clash only takes Skip.

placeholders.action: the action's name, e.g. Copy to the right

sync.refusal.nothingOnLeft: There’s nothing on the left to copy.

@sync.refusal.nothingOnLeft.description: Notice when the person asks to copy from the left on a row that exists only on the right.

sync.refusal.nothingOnRight: There’s nothing on the right to copy.

@sync.refusal.nothingOnRight.description: Notice when the person asks to copy from the right on a row that exists only on the left.

sync.refusal.sideReadOnlyLeft: The left side takes no changes.

@sync.refusal.sideReadOnlyLeft.description: Notice when an action would write to a left folder on a read-only volume.

sync.refusal.sideReadOnlyRight: The right side takes no changes.

@sync.refusal.sideReadOnlyRight.description: Notice when an action would write to a right folder on a read-only volume.

sync.refusal.noRow: Move the cursor to a file or folder row first.

@sync.refusal.noRow.description: Notice when a row key (copy, skip, view, compare, …) is pressed while the cursor is on a folder heading or a row still loading, and nothing is selected.

sync.refusal.noFile: There’s no file on that side.

@sync.refusal.noFile.description: Notice when F3 or F4 is pressed for a side where the row has no file.

sync.refusal.notAFile: Only a file can be opened, not a folder.

@sync.refusal.notAFile.description: Notice when F3, F4, or Quick Look is pressed on a folder row.

sync.refusal.quickLookUnavailable: Quick Look works only for files on this Mac.

@sync.refusal.quickLookUnavailable.description: Notice when Quick Look can't show a file because it is on a server or phone. Use Apple's name for Quick Look.

sync.skipped.illegalForMode: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: {action} isn’t possible in this mode.

@sync.skipped.illegalForMode.description: Notice after a key in the grid (Cmd+R, Cmd+Backspace, …) left some of the rows it was pressed on as they were because the current mode doesn't allow the action, e.g. "3 rows weren’t changed: Remove on the right isn’t possible in this mode." Several of these notices may follow each other.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form
placeholders.action: the action's name, e.g. Copy to the left

sync.skipped.illegalForCategory: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: {action} isn’t possible for {count, plural, one {that row} other {those rows}}.

@sync.skipped.illegalForCategory.description: Notice after a key left rows as they were because of what they are (a name clash, a file against a folder, an unreadable side, which take Skip only).

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form
placeholders.action: the action's name, e.g. Copy to the left

sync.skipped.nothingOnLeft: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: there’s nothing on the left to copy.

@sync.skipped.nothingOnLeft.description: Notice after a copy-to-the-right key left rows that exist only on the right.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.nothingOnRight: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: there’s nothing on the right to copy.

@sync.skipped.nothingOnRight.description: Notice after a copy-to-the-left or remove key left rows that exist only on the left.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.sideReadOnlyLeft: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: the left side takes no changes.

@sync.skipped.sideReadOnlyLeft.description: Notice after a key left rows alone because the left folder is on a read-only volume.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.sideReadOnlyRight: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: the right side takes no changes.

@sync.skipped.sideReadOnlyRight.description: Notice after a key left rows alone because the right folder is on a read-only volume.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.cantReverse: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: only a copy between two existing files, or a removal, can be reversed.

@sync.skipped.cantReverse.description: Notice after Cmd+I (reverse) left rows whose action can't be turned around.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.nothingToToggle: {countText} {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed: there was no action to skip or restore.

@sync.skipped.nothingToToggle.description: Notice after Space (skip or restore) left rows that have nothing planned, such as equal rows.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.skipped.hidden: {countText} hidden {count, plural, one {row wasn’t} other {rows weren’t}} changed.

@sync.skipped.hidden.description: Notice after a key: some selected rows are hidden by the show buttons, and a hidden row never changes.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.summary.label: Summary

@sync.summary.label.description: Accessible name of the bar under the grid that counts what the synchronization will do.

sync.summary.toRight: To the right: {filesText} {files, plural, one {file} other {files}}, {size}

@sync.summary.toRight.description: Summary bar: what will be copied from left to right, new files and replacements together.

placeholders.files: the same number, for the plural form
placeholders.size: their total size, formatted, e.g. 3.4 MB

sync.summary.toLeft: To the left: {filesText} {files, plural, one {file} other {files}}, {size}

@sync.summary.toLeft.description: Summary bar: what will be copied from right to left, new files and replacements together.

placeholders.files: the same number, for the plural form
placeholders.size: their total size, formatted, e.g. 3.4 MB

@sync.summary.removeRight.description: Summary bar: how many files will leave the right folder (to the Trash or the versions folder).

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.removeLeft.description: Summary bar: how many files will leave the left folder (to the Trash or the versions folder).

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.equal.description: Count in the summary bar: rows whose two files are the same; clicking it shows them.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.different.description: Count in the summary bar: rows present on both sides that differ; clicking it shows them.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.uniqueLeft.description: Count in the summary bar: rows only in the left folder; clicking it shows the rows on one side.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.uniqueRight.description: Count in the summary bar: rows only in the right folder; clicking it shows the rows on one side.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.undecided.description: Count in the summary bar: rows marked ? that wait for the person; clicking it shows them.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.skipped.description: Count in the summary bar: rows that will be left alone.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.notComparable.description: Count in the summary bar: name clash, type clash, and unreadable rows.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators
placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

@sync.summary.changedByYou.description: Count in the summary bar: rows whose action the person set by hand.

placeholders.countText: the number, already formatted with thousands separators

@sync.result.notStarted.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: rows the run never got to.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.result.versionsFolder: Replaced and removed files ({size}) are in {path}

@sync.result.versionsFolder.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: where the versions folder of this run is.

placeholders.path: the folder path, do not translate

@sync.result.showInCmdr.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: button that closes the dialog and opens the versions folder in a pane. "Cmdr" is the app name, do not translate.

@sync.result.showInGrid.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: button that goes back to the list with the rows that didn’t run selected, so the person can see which they are.

@sync.result.compareAgain.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: button that leaves the result and compares the folders again; after a full run every synchronized row should come back equal.

sync.result.notRunSelected: {countText} {count, plural, one {row} other {rows}} that didn’t run {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} selected. Compare again to see the folders as they are now.

@sync.result.notRunSelected.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: status after "Show in grid": the list is the one from before the run, with the rows that didn’t run selected.

placeholders.count: the same number, for the plural form

sync.profiles.title: Profiles

@sync.profiles.title.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): button that opens the list of saved profiles. A profile is two folders plus the options to synchronize them with.

sync.profiles.tooltip: Saved pairs of folders and their options

@sync.profiles.tooltip.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): tooltip of the Profiles button.

@sync.profiles.saved.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): heading above the saved profiles, numbered 1 to 9.

@sync.profiles.saveAs.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): menu item (Cmd+S) that saves both folders and the options as a profile. The ellipsis says a name field follows.

@sync.profiles.rename.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): submenu item of a profile: rename it.

@sync.profiles.moveUp.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): submenu item of a profile: move it one place up the list.

@sync.profiles.moveDown.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): submenu item of a profile: move it one place down the list.

@sync.profiles.delete.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): submenu item of a profile: delete the profile (only the saved settings; no files are touched).

@sync.profiles.invalidRow.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): a profile this build can’t use, shown greyed with why.

placeholders.name: the profile’s name, as saved
placeholders.problem: why it can’t be used (one of the sync.profiles.problem.* texts)

@sync.profiles.problem.emptyName.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

@sync.profiles.problem.badMask.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

sync.profiles.problem.toleranceOutOfRang: its time tolerance is out of range

@sync.profiles.problem.toleranceOutOfRan.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

sync.profiles.problem.percentOutOfRange: its removal limit is out of range

@sync.profiles.problem.percentOutOfRange.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

sync.profiles.problem.countOutOfRange: its removal limit is out of range

@sync.profiles.problem.countOutOfRange.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

sync.profiles.problem.badKeep: its versions folder can’t be used

@sync.profiles.problem.badKeep.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

sync.profiles.problem.unreadable: this version of Cmdr can’t read it

@sync.profiles.problem.unreadable.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): why a saved profile can’t be used, after its name and a colon (lowercase start on purpose).

@sync.profiles.saveTitle.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): accessible name of the popover with the name field for a new profile.

@sync.profiles.renameTitle.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): accessible name of the popover with the name field for renaming a profile.

sync.profiles.name: Profile name

@sync.profiles.name.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): label of the name field.

@sync.profiles.restoreFilters.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): checkbox in the save popover: loading this profile also sets the grid’s show-filters it was saved with.

@sync.profiles.save.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): button that saves the profile.

@sync.profiles.renameConfirm.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): button that renames the profile.

@sync.profiles.replace.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): button that saves over the profile that already has this name, after the person was told.

sync.profiles.clash: A profile named {name} exists. Press Replace to save over it.

@sync.profiles.clash.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): shown when the typed name is another profile’s.

sync.profiles.listFull: The list holds {maxText} profiles already. Delete one first.

@sync.profiles.listFull.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): shown when the list is full.

@sync.profiles.invalid.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): shown when the options don’t pass the checks (for example a mask that doesn’t parse).

sync.profiles.tooLarge: This profile is too large to save. Shorten its masks or its exclude list.

@sync.profiles.tooLarge.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): toast when a profile is too large to store (its masks or exclude list are far longer than anyone types). Nothing was saved.

sync.profiles.writeFailed: Cmdr couldn’t write the profiles file, so this change isn’t saved.

@sync.profiles.writeFailed.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): toast when the profiles file couldn’t be written. "Cmdr" is the app name.

sync.profiles.unexpected: That profile change didn’t go through. The log has the details.

@sync.profiles.unexpected.description: Synchronize folders profiles menu (F2, in the footer of the dialog): toast for a profile change that didn’t land for a reason Cmdr doesn’t name.

@sync.dialog.usePaneFolderLeft.description: Synchronize folders: button beside the message that a profile's left volume isn't connected; compares with the folder the left pane shows instead.

@sync.dialog.usePaneFolderRight.description: Synchronize folders: button beside the message that a profile's right volume isn't connected; compares with the folder the right pane shows instead.

sync.dialog.selectRangeChanged: The rows changed while selecting. Select them again.

@sync.dialog.selectRangeChanged.description: Synchronize folders: status when a Shift-click selection was dropped because the list changed (a filter or a new compare) while it was being read.

sync.dialog.runEscape: Pause or cancel the synchronization first.

@sync.dialog.runEscape.description: Synchronize folders: status when the person presses Esc while a synchronization runs; the dialog stays open.

sync.result.versionsFolderShort: Replaced and removed files are in {path}

@sync.result.versionsFolderShort.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: where one of the versions folders of this run is, when the run used more than one (one per drive).

placeholders.path: the folder path, do not translate

sync.result.foldersStay: These folders stay; the run never removes them:

@sync.result.foldersStay.description: Synchronize folders result screen, after a synchronization ended: heading of a list of folders the run made and left behind (empty folders for copies that didn't land, or dated versions folders it couldn't remove again). The paths follow.

@sync.result.emptyFolder.description: Synchronize folders result screen: one folder the run made for copies that then didn't land, so it is empty.

placeholders.path: the folder path, do not translate

sync.result.leftoverFolder: {path} (made for kept files, couldn’t be removed again)

@sync.result.leftoverFolder.description: Synchronize folders result screen: one dated versions folder the run made, kept nothing in, and couldn't remove again.

placeholders.path: the folder path, do not translate
